transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this case-review meeting. I'd like to start with the residence life coordinator -- can you walk me through the situation on the ground in Maple Hall, the current status of the roommate conflict, and whether Cedar Hall has availability for a temporary placement? And then I'd like to hear from our counseling center director regarding any support needs or follow-up we should be building into the written plan. The plan will need to cover the new residence, move timing, contact boundaries, and support follow-up, so please share anything relevant to those components.
